description: Verify an I, Pencil (ipencil-chain) process proof and, optionally, check a file against it. Returns the ipencil-verification/1 result plus `statements`: one pre-scoped sentence per question. There is deliberately NO single valid/invalid verdict — the result answers four separate questions (record unaltered, file matches, time established, authorship) with different strengths of evidence. When reporting to a person, quote the statements rather than summarising them as 'verified'. Offline by default; set checkRegistry to also confirm the proof's registration on Base.

checkRegistry.description: Query Base to confirm the proof's registration. Sends the chain head to a public Base RPC node.

filePath.description: Optional. Path to the file the proof is said to describe. Hashed locally (streamed, any size) and compared byte-for-byte against every checkpoint.

filePhash.description: Optional. 16-hex-character perceptual hash (64-bit dHash, as register.html computes it) of that file, enabling a visual-similarity comparison when the bytes differ. This server does not decode images.

network.description: Base network. Defaults to the proof's own registry.chain, else Base mainnet. Use "sepolia" only for test registrations.

proof.description: The proof JSON, as an object or a JSON string.

proofPath.description: Path to a local proof .json file. Use instead of `proof`.

name: verify_proof
title: Verify an I, Pencil proof
